sources.summary: The queen of pop returns with a new album of pristine dancefloor bangers, while the begoggled yellow munchkins indulge in a spot of time travel Minions & Monsters Out now In this latest minions adventure, the yellow critters jump back in time to attempt to source some monsters so they can produce their own creature feature. As ever, the premise is largely an excuse to string a load of jokes together – and why not? Continue reading...
